editorialRules: Do not fabricate ratings, box-office figures, release dates, cast, OTT availability or trend values.
Use approved/licensed sources and preserve source attribution where required.
Treat search trends as discovery signals, not evidence of a factual claim.
Prefer one canonical entity page plus focused supporting articles instead of duplicate pages.
Re-verify time-sensitive values before publication or major updates.
